title: New MSFS 2024 Marketplace activities! | Worth your hard-earned credits?
description:
The weekly Microsoft Flight Simulator Marketplace update is here, and this time we are diving deep into a massive wave of new activities from Perfect Flight built to take your pilot career to the next level in MSFS 2024.

Early community feedback is pouring in, with some highly rated five-star packages stirring up some serious talk across the community. Whether you want to conquer high-stakes commercial airliner schedules, test your skills on a grueling heavy jumbo landing, or escape on an ultra-precise VFR sightseeing tour over iconic landmarks, these releases deliver a perfect excuse to jump back into the left seat. To help you choose if they are worth your hard-earned marketplace credits, we are breaking down everything included in these new additions:

First up, we are analyzing the high-stakes airline operations and precision challenges. This includes the "A321 Captain United Coasters" pack featuring 8 highly realistic IFR legs for the iniBuilds A321neo, packed with authentic aviation styles and over 100 distinct events across its transcontinental route. If you want a real test of reflexes, we also look at the new Advanced Challenges pack designed for the massive A380, putting your heavy jetliner handling skills to the test across 24 unique global proving grounds (Tip: We recommend pairing this with the FlyByWire A380X!).

Next, group two throws you directly into the remote wilderness with the "Scenic Wilderness VFR Tours" series. This bush flying expedition takes you across Maine's rocky Atlantic shorelines, deep forest corridors, and northern frontier communities—complete with custom audio recordings and interactive monitoring tools that make it a perfect companion for immersive low and slow flying.

✈️ What do you think? Are you planning to pick up the scenic VFR tours, or are you going to stick to the high-stakes heavy airliner runs? Let me know your thoughts in the comment section below!

Don't forget to like, subscribe for weekly simulator updates, and clear skies on your next departure!
